items.title: Which Amazon Report Task Should You Automate First?
items.zh_title: 亚马逊报表任务，先自动化哪一个？
items.zh_oneliner: 先从数据采集和异常复核入手，用小范围试点测算自动化能省出多少人力。
items.en_oneliner: Start with data collection and exception review, and use a small pilot to estimate how much staff capacity automation can free up.
